body:
Hi team,

I was looking at Kendrick's website this week. You have been serving the greater Atlanta area since 1986 and you hold a 4.9 rating from more than 270 Google reviews, but your homepage shows exactly one customer review, and your phone number appears once, right down at the bottom in the contact block. The plumbing section also introduces your services as help with a variety of plumbing pumps, which is a small slice of what a master plumbing and gas shop actually does.

So I redesigned your homepage, and the finished design is attached to this email as a PDF. It leads with your plumbing and gas services, puts the 770.590.5006 number where people can find it in seconds, and gives your reviews the front-page spot they deserve.

I build websites for home service companies. Two plumbing sites I have done: Total Plumbing (totalplumbing.net), a Dallas plumber with a clean, fast site built for people searching on their phones, and Big Birge Plumbing (bigbirgeplumbing.com).

If you like the design, I can build out the full site from it. If not, keep the PDF as free ideas, no hard feelings either way.

Best,
Hassan
name: Kendrick Plumbing
subject: 🔧 Your homepage shows one review. Google shows over 270.
